integrity: Mathematical statements rely on included exact finite certificates, discrete Morse theory and Hurewicz; the finding has not received independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The sphere-wedge type is nonequivariant; homology representation decompositions and orbit-space conclusions are rational. Integral representation lattices, equivariant homotopy splitting, and integral quotient homology remain open. Publication priority remains subject to independently locating any uncatalogued equivalent results.
title: The Petersen matching complex as a mixed sphere wedge with distinct symmetric-group homology modules
